name: Upstage
summary: Solar Mini 4 (2026-09-22) through the standard Chat transport. Own private API key required; account access and budget remain unverified.

credentials.label: Upstage API key
credentials.help: Create a key for the intended account or organization in the official console. Enter it privately in lain; never in chat, logs or route settings.

setupSteps.title: Select the intended organization and key
setupSteps.description: Create or choose an API key in the Upstage organization that owns the intended credits. Enter it privately in lain.

setupSteps.title: Confirm trial and billing state
setupSteps.description: Inspect credits and expiry privately in Console. A payment method can cause paid usage after credits run out. No purchase, card addition or auto-recharge is needed for preparation.

setupSteps.title: Save a pinned model route
setupSteps.description: Use solar-mini4-260922 at the global https://api.upstage.ai/v1 endpoint. Saving does not spend credits or prove live access.

billingPlans.name: Upstage introductory credits
billingPlans.notes: Official signup offer advertises $10. Granted amount, current balance, expiry and card requirement are unverified; no recurring free API allowance is claimed.

billingPlans.name: Pay as you go / subscription
billingPlans.notes: Production access billed per use or by an existing subscription. Prices and entitlement for this account are not read by lain; no purchase is performed.
